title: Key moments in the debate, 1987 to 2027
subtitle: Founding statements and recent denominational decisions
caption: The two founding statements came within two years of each other; most of the recent movement has come in the Southern Baptist Convention.

cells: Christians for Biblical Equality is incorporated, first as "Men, Women and God: Christians for Biblical Equality."
The Council on Biblical Manhood and Womanhood drafts the Danvers Statement in Danvers, Massachusetts; the final form is published in November 1988.
July 1989
CBE presents its statement "Men, Women, and Biblical Equality" at its first international conference, in St. Paul.
The Southern Baptist Convention adopts the Baptist Faith and Message 2000.
Sept. 2017
ACNA bishops leave the ordination of women as deacons and priests to each diocese and agree women will not be consecrated as bishops.
Saddleback Church ordains its first three women pastors.
Southern Baptists amend Article VI of the Baptist Faith and Message to limit "the office of pastor/elder/overseer" to men.
June 2023
Messengers uphold the removal of Saddleback Church and Fern Creek Baptist Church over women pastors.
The Law amendment falls short on its second vote, at 61.45 percent.
A new amendment on women pastors gets 60.74%, short of two-thirds.
The Truth and Unity Amendment passes its first vote with 74.6%.
Calvary Chapel Costa Mesa says it ordains women as pastors.
The Truth and Unity Amendment needs a second two-thirds vote at the next annual meeting.
